exceptions.reason: The runner must read the token volume produced with container-root ownership by the separate Forgejo authority.
mitigations: Container UID 0 maps to the dedicated unprivileged runner host account.
The shared token and SSH key mounts are read only inside the runner.

exceptions.reason: Forgejo Actions jobs require the dedicated rootless Podman API to create their isolated job containers.
mitigations: The runner uses a dedicated unprivileged host account and socket.
Job execution is restricted to trusted organization repositories.
